views.desc_en: low wide shot at flower height from just inside the tiny door, oversized box edging and pelargoniums in the foreground, the white rose-tree and the garden rising beyond
eye-level medium shot from beside the huge terracotta flower-pot on the white rose-tree and the gardeners' paint-pots at its bed
eye-level wide shot from under the gilded arbour arch looking west along the broad walk into the low sun, the way the procession comes
eye-level medium shot from the rose-tree bed across the broad walk to the mosaic roundel where the procession halts opposite
high oblique wide shot from above the lily fountain across the broad walk and the card-suit carpet beds toward the spade-shaped flower-bed and the garden wall
eye-level medium shot from the mosaic roundel up the cross walk to the lily fountain and its single jet
eye-level detail from beside the wheelbarrow on white roses wet with fresh red paint, drips on leaves and gravel
eye-level close shot from the rose-tree bed on the tiny door in the garden wall under its carved halo roundel
low close shot from the edge of the spade-shaped flower-bed on the huge terracotta flower-pot where the gardeners hide

calibration_note_en: Coordinates re-read from the rendered image 2026-09-23 (ground-contact points). The tiny door is the gap between two piers in the south wall. Broad walk centre line y=0.42. A fourth, diamond-shaped bed sits at about [0.43, 0.12]; the club-shaped bed sits at about [0.77, 0.14].

checklist.camera_orthographic: NO: the camera is tilted about 30-40 deg from vertical; the south wall shows its face and gate piers; the arbour arch shows in side view
